issues.detail: The Greek 'αυτω' (autō) indicates the daughter was *his* (the father's). The Vietnamese translation 'có một con gái độc nhất' omits the possessive relationship to the subject.

The Greek 'εν δε τω υπαγειν αυτον' means 'while he was going/leaving'. The Vietnamese 'Nhưng khi Ngài đi' uses 'Nhưng' (But), which is not present in the Greek and creates a contrastive transition that isn't in the source.
